card.name: Section cross-reference openers and 'Chief of'
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis or section number of a label cross-reference like (5.3, 8.1) at the end of a warning sentence. Also 'of' after a title word such as Chief or Limitations.

modes.label: Cross-reference citations
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or digit in a section number citation ending a warning or dosing statement in a drug label highlights.
modes.example: Apprise pregnant women of the potential hazard to the fetus.<< (>> 5.3 , 8.

modes.label: 'of' after a title
modes.description: The word 'of' after Chief or Limitations, before a following role or section name.
modes.example: The judges in all these trials were American, and so were the prosecutors; the Chief<< of>> Counsel for the Prosecution was Brig

card.plain: It marks the spot where a label points to another section by number, and also the word 'of' in titles like Chief of Staff.
